pillars.name: Chia Bech32m Identity & DID CHIP-0002 Auth
pillars.purpose: Every cognitive store, memory capsule commit, and Alignment Lobe guardrail in dbrain.to is cryptographically attributed to a sovereign Chia identity (`xch1...`, `txch1...`, or `did:chia:...`). This module implements the normative BIP-350 Bech32m (`0x2bc830a3`) address codec over `GF(2^5)` backed by the Rust/WASM polynomial checksum engine, together with short-lived `CHIP-0002` DID challenge-response authentication for zero-trust operator and agent endpoints.
invariants: Strict Bech32m Constant (`0x2bc830a3`): Legacy BIP-173 Bech32 (`1`) checksums, mixed-case strings, and non-32-byte puzzle hashes are rejected.

Alignment Allowlist Enforcement: `normalizeAdminDid`, `createDidChallenge`, and `verifyDidChallengeResponse` fail closed (`null` / HTTP `403`) unless the canonicalized `did:chia:{address}` is explicitly present in `allowlistSet`.
Replay-Bounded Challenge TTL: Every `CHIP-0002` challenge carries a fresh 256-bit CSPRNG nonce and expires strictly after 60,000 milliseconds.

subModules.title: Hybrid Asymmetric Classical (RFC-8032 Ed25519) & Post-Quantum (WOTS+-SHA256) Cryptography
subModules.purpose: Keyless hash digests (`SHA-512(...)`) prove data integrity against accidental corruption, but any attacker who modifies a payload can trivially recompute a matching keyless hash. True cryptographic provenance requires asymmetric private-key signing paired with zero-secret public-key verification—and long-lived cognitive memories must survive both classical adversaries and future fault-tolerant quantum computers running Shor's algorithm. This sub-module implements a zero-dependency (`node:crypto`) Hybrid Classical + Post-Quantum asymmetric signature suite: 1. Classical Asymmetric Layer (`RFC-8032 Ed25519` via RFC-8410 ASN.1 DER): 32-byte private seeds, 32-byte public keys, and deterministic 64-byte elliptic-curve Schnorr signatures verified via `crypto.verify`. 2. Post-Quantum Asymmetric Layer (`RFC-8391 / FIPS-205 WOTS+-SHA256`, `w = 16`): 67-chain Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus (`64` base-16 message nibbles + `3` monotone anti-forgery checksum nibbles) with randomized bitmask tweaks, verified strictly from the 32-byte `pqcPublicKeyHex` and 16-byte `pubSeedHex` with zero private key access.

subModules.title: Canonical Chia Consensus Primitives, CLVM Tree-Hasher, Currying & chia-dao-v1 Verifier
subModules.purpose: Chia's coin-set model and Chialisp/Rue smart contracts enforce bit-exact consensus rules that trip up floating-point and naive hashing code: 1. Coin IDs hash `parent_coin_info || puzzle_hash || int_to_bytes(amount)` where `int_to_bytes` is signed two's-complement minimal CLVM encoding (`0n` -> empty bytes, `128n` -> `0x0080`, `-113n` -> `0x8f`), NOT fixed-width uint64. 2. XCH (`10^12` mojos/XCH) and CAT2 (`10^3` mojos/CAT) amounts require exact `BigInt` string parsing (`parseDecimalToUnits`) with zero IEEE-754 float multiplication. 3. Coin puzzle hashes are CLVM `sha256tree` roots of curried puzzle programs (`p2_delegated_puzzle_or_hidden_puzzle`, `cat_v2`, and the 12-puzzle `chia-dao-v1` Opus Chialisp + Rue `v0.11.0` suite), never raw `SHA-256(pubkey)`.

subModules.title: Fail-Closed Gate-0 Write Safety, Provider SSRF/Key-Pinning, Vault Sanitization & CSPRNG Seed Custody
subModules.purpose: `@dbrain/core` is deployed standalone and inside distributed clusters (`dbrain serve`, `dbrain-mcp`, library embeds, civic public-library nodes) where writes arrive directly over REST, stdio MCP, P2P Morphic Gossip, and Obsidian/`gbrain` Markdown Vault imports. This zero-dependency Layer-1 sub-module provides deterministic, fail-closed security primitives inside `@dbrain/core` itself: 1. Mandatory Gate-0 Pre-Write Safety (`evaluateGate0WriteSafety`): blocks leaked API keys/PEM private keys, Unicode BiDi/zero-width smuggling, cloaked override directives, and `AB-*` Fuzzy LSH Antibody matches. 2. Pluggable Provider SSRF & Bearer-Key Host-Pinning (`validateProviderEndpointSafety`): prevents caller-supplied `endpointUrl` overrides from probing cloud metadata (`169.254.169.254`), local Chia RPC ports (`8555`), or leaking `DBRAIN_EMBEDDING_API_KEY` across origins. 3. Second-Brain Markdown Vault Sanitization (`sanitizeVaultImportNote`): blocks `..`/absolute/null-byte path traversal, strips cloaked HTML comment prompt injections, and clamps untrusted YAML frontmatter out of `alignment` and `PUBLIC_SHARED_CORTEX`. 4. Persisted `0600` CSPRNG Node Seed Custody (`loadOrCreatePersistedNodeSeed`): replaces predictable hardcoded fallback seed strings with durable permission-locked (`0600`) CSPRNG node identity keys.

symbols.name: ED25519_PKCS8_PREFIX
symbols.summary: 16-byte RFC-8410 PKCS#8 DER header for raw 32-byte `Ed25519` private seeds.
symbols.description: RFC-8410 ASN.1 PKCS#8 DER prefix wrapping a raw 32-byte `Ed25519` private seed (`OID 1.3.101.112`) for `crypto.createPrivateKey`.

symbols.name: ED25519_SPKI_PREFIX
symbols.summary: 12-byte RFC-8410 SPKI DER header for raw 32-byte `Ed25519` public keys.
symbols.description: RFC-8410 ASN.1 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (`SPKI`) DER prefix wrapping a raw 32-byte `Ed25519` public key (`OID 1.3.101.112`) for `crypto.createPublicKey`.

symbols.name: P256_PKCS8_PREFIX
symbols.summary: 36-byte PKCS#8 DER header for 32-byte NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`) private scalars.
symbols.description: RFC-5915 / PKCS#8 ASN.1 DER prefix wrapping a 32-byte NIST P-256 (`secp256r1` / `prime256v1`) private scalar (`OID 1.2.840.10045.3.1.7`).

symbols.name: P256_SPKI_PREFIX
symbols.summary: 26-byte SPKI DER header for uncompressed 65-byte NIST P-256 public keys.
symbols.description: RFC-5480 ASN.1 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (`SPKI`) DER prefix wrapping an uncompressed 65-byte NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`) public point (`0x04 || X || Y`).

symbols.name: WOTS_PLUS_CHAINS
symbols.summary: Total `WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`) hash chain count (`67`).
symbols.description: Total number of Winternitz `w = 16` hash chains in `WOTS+-SHA256`: `64` base-16 message nibbles (`256 / 4`) + `3` base-16 checksum nibbles (`67`).

symbols.name: normalizeSeed32
symbols.summary: Normalizes or generates a 32-byte cryptographic seed `Buffer`.
symbols.description: Normalizes a private seed input into an exact 32-byte `Buffer`: generates 32 CSPRNG bytes when omitted, decodes exact 64-hex strings / 32-byte Buffers directly, or derives 32 bytes via `HKDF-SHA256` from arbitrary key material.

params.name: seedInput
params.description: Raw 32-byte seed, 64-char hex seed, passphrase/DID seed, or `null` for CSPRNG.

params.name: domain
params.description: HKDF info domain string when deriving from arbitrary strings.

symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: deriveEd25519Keypair
symbols.summary: Generates or deterministically derives an `RFC-8032 Ed25519` 32-byte keypair.
symbols.description: Derives an `RFC-8032 Ed25519` asymmetric keypair from a 32-byte seed (or fresh CSPRNG entropy when omitted), returning `0x`-prefixed 32-byte hex encodings of the private seed and raw public key.
symbols.complexity: O(1) elliptic-curve scalar multiplication on Curve25519.

symbols.name: signEd25519Message
symbols.summary: Signs a message with an `RFC-8032 Ed25519` private key seed.
symbols.description: Signs a UTF-8 message string or `Buffer` using a private `RFC-8032 Ed25519` 32-byte seed and returns the 64-byte signature (`0x` + 128 hex) alongside the signer's 32-byte `publicKeyHex`.
symbols.complexity: O(M) time where M is `message` byte length.

symbols.name: verifyEd25519Signature
symbols.summary: Verifies an `RFC-8032 Ed25519` signature using only the 32-byte `publicKeyHex`.
symbols.description: Verifies a 64-byte `RFC-8032 Ed25519` signature against a 32-byte public key with zero private-key knowledge, returning `false` on any malformed hex length, invalid curve point, or 1-bit message/signature modification.

returns.description: `true` if and only if `signatureHex` is a valid Ed25519 signature over `message` under `publicKeyHex`.

symbols.complexity: O(M) time where M is `message` byte length.
symbols.example: const ok = verifyEd25519Signature('hello', signed.signatureHex, signed.publicKeyHex); // true

symbols.name: deriveSecp256r1Keypair
symbols.summary: Derives a NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`) keypair for `CHIP-0043` Secure Enclave / Passkey signing.
symbols.description: Derives a NIST P-256 (`secp256r1` / `prime256v1`) asymmetric keypair for `CHIP-0043` Passkey / Secure Enclave custody members, returning the 32-byte scalar seed, 33-byte SEC1 compressed public key (`02`/`03 || X`), and 65-byte uncompressed public point (`04 || X || Y`).

returns.type: { seedHex: string, publicKeyHex: string, uncompressedPublicKeyHex: string }
returns.description: `0x`-prefixed scalar, 33-byte compressed key, and 65-byte uncompressed key.

symbols.complexity: O(1) elliptic-curve scalar multiplication on `prime256v1`.

symbols.name: signSecp256r1Message
symbols.summary: Signs a message with NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`) ECDSA-SHA256 (`IEEE-P1363` 64-byte `r || s`).
symbols.description: Signs a UTF-8 message string or `Buffer` with ECDSA-SHA256 over NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`, IEEE P1363 fixed-width 64-byte `r || s` encoding) for `CHIP-0043` `secp256r1_member_v1` Clear-Signing envelopes.

returns.description: 64-byte IEEE-P1363 ECDSA signature and 33-byte compressed public key.

symbols.complexity: O(M) time where M is `message` byte length.

symbols.name: verifySecp256r1Signature
symbols.summary: Verifies a NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`) ECDSA-SHA256 signature using only `publicKeyHex`.
symbols.description: Verifies an IEEE-P1363 64-byte NIST P-256 (`secp256r1`) ECDSA-SHA256 signature against a 33-byte compressed or 65-byte uncompressed SEC1 public key with zero private-key knowledge.

params.name: publicKeyHex
params.description: `0x`-prefixed or raw 66-hex (33-byte compressed) or 130-hex (65-byte uncompressed) SEC1 public key.

returns.description: `true` if and only if `signatureHex` is a valid P-256 ECDSA-SHA256 signature over `message`.

symbols.complexity: O(M) time where M is `message` byte length.

symbols.name: computeWotsPlusBase16Digits
symbols.summary: Maps a message and 16-byte public seed into 67 Winternitz `w = 16` chain step counts (`0..15`).
symbols.description: Computes the 67 base-16 Winternitz (`w = 16`) chain lengths for `WOTS+-SHA256`: `64` 4-bit message digest nibbles `m_0..m_{63}` followed by `3` 4-bit checksum nibbles encoding `C = sum_{i=0}^{63} (15 - m_i)` (`0 <= C <= 960 < 4096`).
symbols.complexity: O(M) time for 1 SHA-256 message hash and O(1) space (`67` bytes).

symbols.name: advanceWotsPlusChain
symbols.signature: function advanceWotsPlusChain(startNode32, startStep, steps, pubSeed16, chainIdx)
symbols.summary: Advances a single `WOTS+-SHA256` chain by `steps` bitmask-tweaked SHA-256 iterations.
symbols.description: Advances a 32-byte `WOTS+-SHA256` hash-chain node from `startStep` by `steps` iterations using RFC-8391 §3.1.2 bitmask randomization: `mask = SHA-256(0x00 || pubSeed16 || u16be(chainIdx) || u8(step))` `next = SHA-256(0x01 || pubSeed16 || u16be(chainIdx) || u8(step) || (cur XOR mask))`

params.name: steps
params.description: Number of forward steps to execute (`0..15`).

symbols.complexity: O(steps) (`<= 15` SHA-256 pairs) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: deriveWotsPlusKeypair
symbols.summary: Derives a Post-Quantum `WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`) compressed 32-byte public key root.
symbols.description: Derives a Post-Quantum `WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`, 67-chain) public key root (`pqcPublicKeyHex`) and 16-byte `pubSeedHex` from a 32-byte secret seed.

params.name: pubSeedInput
params.description: Optional 16-byte public tweak seed (`32` hex chars).

returns.type: { secretSeedHex: string, pubSeedHex: string, pqcPublicKeyHex: string }
returns.description: Secret seed, public seed, and 32-byte PQC public key commitment.

symbols.complexity: O(1) (`67 * 15 = 1,005` tweakable SHA-256 steps, `~0.7 ms`).

symbols.name: signWotsPlusSha256
symbols.signature: function signWotsPlusSha256(message, secretSeedInput = null, pubSeedInput = null)
symbols.summary: Generates a Post-Quantum `WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`) asymmetric signature (`2,144` bytes `base64url`).
symbols.description: Signs an arbitrary message with Post-Quantum `WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`, 67 chains), advancing chain `i` by `b_i` steps to form the `2,144`-byte signature and continuing the remaining `15 - b_i` steps in the same single pass to emit the matching `pqcPublicKeyHex`.

returns.type: { signatureBase64Url: string, signatureDigestHex: string, pqcPublicKeyHex: string, pubSeedHex: string }
returns.description: Post-Quantum signature and public verification parameters.

symbols.complexity: O(M) message hash + `1,005` fixed SHA-256 chain steps (`~0.7 ms`).

symbols.name: verifyWotsPlusSha256
symbols.summary: Verifies a Post-Quantum `WOTS+-SHA256` signature purely from `pqcPublicKeyHex` and `pubSeedHex`.
symbols.description: Verifies a `2,144`-byte `WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`) signature against a 32-byte `pqcPublicKeyHex` and 16-byte `pubSeedHex` with **zero private-key access**: unpacks all 67 chain nodes `\sigma_i`, advances each by `15 - b_i` steps, folds the recovered public key root, and compares in constant time (`timingSafeEqual`).

params.name: pqcPublicKeyHex
params.description: `0x`-prefixed 32-byte WOTS+ public key root (`64` hex chars).

returns.description: `true` if and only if the recovered 67-chain public root equals `pqcPublicKeyHex`.

symbols.complexity: O(M) message hash + `<= 1,005` SHA-256 chain steps (`~0.35 ms` average).
symbols.example: const valid = verifyWotsPlusSha256('capsule-root', pqSig.signatureBase64Url, pqSig.pqcPublicKeyHex, pqSig.pubSeedHex); // true

symbols.name: buildCanonicalCapsuleSigningPreimage
symbols.signature: function buildCanonicalCapsuleSigningPreimage({ id, storeId, key, contentHash, merkleRoot, commitSha, authorDid = 'did:chia:txch1agent' })
symbols.summary: Builds the canonical `DBRAIN-v1.3` capsule signing preimage binding content, Merkle root, and VCS commit.
symbols.description: Formats the domain-separated canonical preimage string signed by both `RFC-8032 Ed25519` and `WOTS+-SHA256` on every `DBRAIN-v1.3` cognitive capsule.
symbols.complexity: O(1) string concatenation.
symbols.example: const preimage = buildCanonicalCapsuleSigningPreimage({ id: 'CAP-1', storeId: '0x1', key: 'k', contentHash: '0x2', merkleRoot: '0x3', commitSha: '0x4' });

symbols.name: signHybridCapsuleEnvelope
symbols.summary: Produces a genuine Hybrid `WOTS+-SHA256 + Ed25519` asymmetric capsule signature envelope.
symbols.description: Signs a `DBRAIN-v1.3` capsule preimage with BOTH classical `RFC-8032 Ed25519` AND Post-Quantum `RFC-8391 WOTS+-SHA256` (`w = 16`, per-commit one-time WOTS+ leaf key derived via `HKDF(signerSeed, commitSha)` so one-time keys are never reused across distinct commits!).

params.name: params.signerSeed
params.description: Signer 32-byte private seed (defaults to deterministic node/DID seed when omitted).

returns.description: Complete `pqcSignature` envelope carrying public keys and dual signatures.

symbols.complexity: O(1) (`1` Ed25519 sign + `1,005` WOTS+-SHA256 steps).
symbols.example: const pqc = signHybridCapsuleEnvelope({ id: 'CAP-1', storeId: '0x1', key: 'k', contentHash: '0x2', merkleRoot: '0x3', commitSha: '0x4' });

symbols.name: verifyHybridCapsuleEnvelope
symbols.summary: Public-key verifies a capsule's `contentHash`, `Ed25519` signature, `WOTS+-SHA256` signature, and binding hash.
symbols.description: Independently verifies BOTH the classical `RFC-8032 Ed25519` signature AND the Post-Quantum `WOTS+-SHA256` signature on a `DBRAIN-v1.3` capsule using ONLY the public keys embedded in `pqcSignature` (plus SHA-256 content hash integrity when `params.content` is present).

returns.type: { verified: boolean, contentHashValid: boolean, ed25519Valid: boolean, wotsPlusPqcValid: boolean, hybridBindingValid: boolean }

symbols.complexity: O(M) content SHA-256 + `1` Ed25519 verify + `<= 1,005` WOTS+-SHA256 chain steps.

symbols.name: CHIA_CONSENSUS_CONSTANTS
symbols.summary: Deep-frozen Chia, DIG Network, and `chia-dao-v1` consensus constants.
symbols.description: Machine-readable Chia consensus, DIG Network, CHIP-0043 MIPS, and `chia-dao-v1` dual-compiler (`opus_chialisp` + `rue`) constants loaded from `puzzles/constants.json`.

symbols.name: normalizeHexBuffer
symbols.summary: Normalizes hex or binary input into a validated `Buffer`.
symbols.description: Normalizes a fixed-width hex string (`0x`-prefixed or bare) or binary buffer into a `Buffer`, validating exact byte length when `expectedBytes` is > 0.

params.name: expectedBytes
params.description: Required byte length (`0` skips length check).

params.name: label
params.description: Field label used in validation error messages.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space where n is byte length.

symbols.name: intToClvmMinimalBytes
symbols.summary: Encodes a `BigInt` into minimal CLVM signed two's-complement bytes.
symbols.description: Encodes a signed integer (`BigInt` or safe integer) into canonical CLVM minimal big-endian signed two's-complement bytes: - `0n` -> `Buffer.alloc(0)` (empty atom) - `n > 0n` -> minimal big-endian bytes, prefixed with `0x00` if `(msb & 0x80) !== 0` - `n < 0n` -> minimal `k`-byte two's-complement (`-113n` -> `0x8f`, `-129n` -> `0xff7f`)
symbols.complexity: O(k) time and O(k) space where k is byte width (`<= 9` for 64-bit amounts).

symbols.name: clvmBytesToBigInt
symbols.summary: Decodes a CLVM signed two's-complement byte buffer into a `BigInt`.
symbols.description: Decodes a CLVM signed two's-complement atom `Buffer` back into a `BigInt`.
symbols.complexity: O(k) time and O(1) auxiliary space where k is `buf.length`.

symbols.name: computeChiaCoinId
symbols.summary: Computes the consensus 32-byte Chia Coin ID using minimal CLVM amount bytes.
symbols.description: Computes a canonical 32-byte Chia Coin ID: `SHA-256(parent_coin_info_32 || puzzle_hash_32 || intToClvmMinimalBytes(amount_mojos))`

params.name: parentCoinInfoHex
params.description: 32-byte parent coin ID (`0x` hex or Buffer).

params.name: puzzleHashHex
params.description: 32-byte coin puzzle hash (`0x` hex or Buffer).

symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space (single SHA-256 over 64..73 bytes).

symbols.name: parseDecimalToUnits
symbols.summary: Converts a human-readable decimal amount into exact `BigInt` base units.
symbols.description: Parses a decimal string, safe integer, or `BigInt` into exact base units (`BigInt`) at `decimals` places (`12` for XCH -> mojos, `3` for CAT2 -> CAT mojos) using pure string arithmetic with zero IEEE-754 floating-point drift.

params.name: decimals
params.description: Decimal places (`12` for XCH, `3` for CAT2).

symbols.complexity: O(d) time and O(d) space where d is string length.

symbols.name: formatUnitsToDecimal
symbols.summary: Formats `BigInt` base units into a canonical decimal string without float loss.
symbols.description: Formats an exact `BigInt` base-unit integer into its canonical human-readable decimal string at `decimals` places, stripping redundant trailing fractional zeros.

params.name: unitsBigInt
params.description: Base-unit count (`BigInt`, number, or integer string).

params.name: decimals
params.description: Decimal places (`12` for XCH, `3` for CAT2).

symbols.complexity: O(d) time and O(d) space.

symbols.name: clvmSha256Atom
symbols.summary: Computes the 32-byte CLVM atom tree hash `SHA-256(0x01 || bytes)`.
symbols.description: Computes `sha256tree` of a CLVM atom: `SHA-256(0x01 || atomBytes)`.
symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: clvmSha256Pair
symbols.summary: Computes the 32-byte CLVM cons-pair tree hash `SHA-256(0x02 || left || right)`.
symbols.description: Computes `sha256tree` of a CLVM cons pair: `SHA-256(0x02 || left32 || right32)`.
symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: clvmCurryHashes
symbols.summary: Curries pre-computed 32-byte argument tree hashes into a CLVM module hash.
symbols.description: Computes the curried 32-byte puzzle hash of a CLVM module (`modHash`) applied to an ordered list of pre-hashed CLVM argument tree hashes: `(a (q . MOD) (c (q . ARG_0) (c (q . ARG_1) ... 1)))`

params.name: argTreeHashes
params.description: Ordered 32-byte tree hashes of curried arguments.

symbols.complexity: O(k) SHA-256 compressions where k is `argTreeHashes.length`.

symbols.name: curryStandardP2PuzzleHash
symbols.summary: Curries a 48-byte BLS12-381 `G1` synthetic key into standard Chia `p2`.
symbols.description: Computes the standard Chia wallet XCH coin puzzle hash by currying a 48-byte BLS12-381 `G1` synthetic public key into `p2_delegated_puzzle_or_hidden_puzzle` (`0xe9aaa49f45bad5c889b86ee3341550c155cfdd10c3a6757de618d20612fffd52`).
symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: curryCat2PuzzleHash
symbols.summary: Computes the outer `cat_v2` coin puzzle hash for `(assetIdHex, innerPuzzleHashHex)`.
symbols.description: Computes a canonical Chia CAT2 outer coin puzzle hash (`CHIP-0038` / `cat_v2`) by currying `(CAT_V2_MOD_HASH, TAIL_HASH, INNER_PUZZLE_HASH)`: - `CAT_V2_MOD_HASH` (`0x37bef360...`) and `TAIL_HASH` are curried as 32-byte atoms - `INNER_PUZZLE_HASH` is already the `sha256tree` root of the inner puzzle
symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: clvmDeserializeHex
symbols.summary: Deserializes serialized CLVM bytecode into a tree-hashed AST.
symbols.description: Deserializes serialized CLVM bytecode (`hex` or `Buffer`) into an AST of `{ type: 'atom', bytes, treeHash }` and `{ type: 'pair', first, rest, treeHash }` nodes, rejecting truncated streams, unsupported 4+-byte atom prefixes, or unconsumed trailing bytes.

params.name: hexOrBuf
params.description: Serialized CLVM program in hex or `Buffer` form.

returns.type: { type: 'atom'|'pair', bytes?: Buffer, first?: Object, rest?: Object, treeHash: Buffer }
returns.description: Root CLVM AST node with precomputed 32-byte `treeHash`.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space where n is serialized byte length.

symbols.name: clvmTreeHashFromHex
symbols.summary: Computes the `0x`-prefixed 32-byte `sha256tree` hash of serialized CLVM hex.
symbols.description: Computes the canonical `0x`-prefixed 32-byte `sha256tree` hash of serialized CLVM bytecode (`.clsp.hex`).
symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space.

symbols.name: decodeQuotedConditionListHex
symbols.summary: Decodes a CLVM condition payload, maps opcodes, and checks `chia-dao-v1` treasury safety.
symbols.description: Decodes a serialized CLVM governance/spend condition list (either quoted as `(q . conditions)` or passed directly as `(cond_0 cond_1 ...)`), mapping all 35 Chia condition opcodes, computing `execHash`, sanitizing `REMARK` text, and verifying strict `chia-dao-v1` `dao_treasury` payload allowlist compliance (`REMARK 0x01` and 4-element `SEND_MESSAGE 0x42` mode `0x12` or `0x17` to a 32-byte receiver only).

params.name: hexOrBuf
params.description: Serialized CLVM condition list (`(q . conditions)` or raw list).

returns.type: { wasQuoted: boolean, execHash: string, conditionCount: number, treasuryPayloadAllowed: boolean, rejectionReasons: string[], conditions: Array<{ opcodeHex: string, opcodeName: string, argsHex: string[], sanitizedRemark?: string, allowedInTreasury: boolean }> }
returns.description: Decoded condition summary and `dao_treasury` allowlist verdict.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space in serialized payload size.

symbols.name: verifyChiaDaoSuiteBytecode
symbols.summary: Recomputes and verifies all 24 `chia-dao-v1` Opus & Rue `sha256tree` mod hashes.
symbols.description: Verifies all 24 vendored `chia-dao-v1` `.clsp.hex` bytecode artifacts on disk (`12` Opus Chialisp modules in `puzzles/opus/` + `12` Rue `v0.11.0` modules in `puzzles/rue/dist/`) against `CHIA_CONSENSUS_CONSTANTS.dao_mod_hashes`.

params.name: options
params.description: Pass `{ forceRecheck: true }` to bypass cached verification.

returns.type: { standard: string, suiteVersion: string, defaultCompiler: string, allVerified: boolean, totalVerifiedCount: number, opusTotalBytes: number, rueTotalBytes: number, byteReductionPct: number, puzzles: Array<{ name: string, opusModHash: string, opusBytes: number, opusVerified: boolean, rueModHash: string, rueBytes: number, rueVerified: boolean }> }

symbols.complexity: O(B) on initial verification (`~55 KB` total bytecode), O(1) when cached.
symbols.example: const res = verifyChiaDaoSuiteBytecode(); // res.allVerified === true, res.totalVerifiedCount === 24

symbols.summary: Computes the curried `p2_dao_vault` inner puzzle hash for a DAO treasury.

symbols.name: curryDaoEscrowPuzzleHash

pillars.name: Normative DIG Network Capsule & Encryption (D1/D2/D5/D8)
pillars.purpose: Decentralized storage peers must be able to host, prove, and stream agent memory capsules without ever seeing plaintext keys or contents. This module implements the normative DIG Network binary protocol: Contract D1 URN addressing (`urn:dig:chia:{storeId}[:{rootHex}]/{key}`), provider-blind `SHA-256(rootless_urn)` retrieval keys, Contract D2 `HKDF-SHA256` + `AES-256-GCM-SIV` chunk encryption, Contract D5/D8 domain-separated binary Merkle proofs with odd-node carry-up, 13-section `DIGS\x01` binary capsule compilation wrapped inside a self-defending `\0asm` WebAssembly module, and indistinguishable deterministic decoy streams on blind-host cache misses.
invariants: Provider-Blind Storage: Resources are indexed and sorted strictly by `SHA-256(rootless_urn)` (`staticKey32`); plaintext paths never enter the `DIGS\x01` Section 8 key table.

Contract D8 Odd-Leaf Carry-Up: When a Merkle tree level has an odd number of nodes, the trailing node is promoted unchanged to the next level without self-hashing, while internal pairs hash with `DIG_NODE_TAG`.

Plausible Deniability on Cache Miss: `buildBlindHostGetContentResponse` returns a deterministic pseudo-random ciphertext stream rather than `404` so external probes cannot enumerate which URNs a blind peer hosts.

symbols.description: Serializes a Contract D5/D8 binary Merkle inclusion proof into wire layout: `leaf32 (32B) || stepCount_u32be (4B) || [sibling32 (32B) || isLeft_u8 (1B)]* || root32 (32B)`.
symbols.complexity: O(d) time and O(d) space where d is tree depth (`steps.length`).
symbols.example: const buf = encodeDigMerkleProofBytes({ leaf32: Buffer.alloc(32), steps: [], root32: Buffer.alloc(32) });

symbols.name: verifyDigMerkleProofBytes
symbols.summary: Verifies a serialized Contract D5/D8 binary Merkle inclusion proof Buffer.
symbols.description: Unpacks and cryptographically verifies a binary Contract D5/D8 Merkle inclusion proof Buffer, checking exact frame byte length, strict boolean `isLeft` tags (`0`/`1`), and constant-length root equality (`acc.equals(root32)`).

params.name: proofBuf
params.description: Packed binary Merkle proof Buffer produced by `encodeDigMerkleProofBytes`.

returns.type: {valid: boolean, reason?: string, leafHex?: string, computedRootHex?: string, rootHex?: string, pathCount?: number, steps?: Array<{siblingHex: string, isLeft: boolean}>}

symbols.complexity: O(d) time and O(d) space where d is the Merkle proof path length.

symbols.name: buildDigMerkleTree
symbols.summary: Builds a Contract D8 binary Merkle tree with odd-leaf carry-up and a `.prove(idx)` generator.
symbols.description: Constructs a binary Merkle tree over 32-byte resource leaves using normative Contract D8 odd-node carry-up promotion (an unpaired trailing node is carried up unchanged without self-duplication, omitting a sibling step at that level).

params.name: leaves32
params.description: Ordered array of 32-byte leaf hash Buffers.

returns.type: {root32: Buffer, rootHex: string, prove: function(number): Buffer}
returns.description: Merkle root and binary inclusion proof generator.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space to build; O(log n) per `prove(leafIndex)` call.

symbols.summary: Encodes an unsigned 32-bit integer as a 4-byte Big-Endian Buffer.
symbols.description: Encodes an unsigned 32-bit integer as a 4-byte Big-Endian Buffer for `DIGS\x01` binary headers.
symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: encodeU64BE
symbols.summary: Encodes an unsigned 64-bit integer / `BigInt` as an 8-byte Big-Endian Buffer.

symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.summary: Length-prefixes a UTF-8 string with a 4-byte Big-Endian `u32` byte count.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space where n is the UTF-8 byte length of `str`.

symbols.name: encodeUleb128
symbols.summary: Encodes an unsigned integer in variable-length WebAssembly `ULEB128` format.
symbols.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer using Unsigned Little-Endian Base-128 (`ULEB128`) variable-length encoding as required by the WebAssembly binary specification.
symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space (at most 5 bytes for any 32-bit integer).

symbols.name: buildSelfDefendingWasmModule
symbols.summary: Wraps a `DIGS\x01` capsule blob inside a valid, self-defending `\0asm` WebAssembly binary.
symbols.description: Wraps a compiled `DIGS\x01` binary capsule blob inside a valid, self-defending WebAssembly v1 module (`\0asm\x01\0\0\0`) that passes `WebAssembly.validate()`, exports `memory` (32..6144 pages) and `serve() -> i32`, and embeds the entire `DIGS\x01` payload inside a custom `'DIGS'` section (`sectionId = 0x00`).
symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space where n is `digsBlobBuf.length`.

symbols.name: parseDigsBlob
symbols.summary: Parses and bounds-checks a 13-section `DIGS\x01` binary capsule Buffer.
symbols.description: Parses and bounds-checks a binary `DIGS\x01` capsule blob: verifies the 9-byte `'DIGS'` v1 header, validates every 10-byte section directory entry `(id, offset, len)`, and decodes Store ID (Sec 1), Merkle Root (Sec 2), JSON Metadata (Sec 6), Provider-Blind Key Table (Sec 8), Chunk Pool count (Sec 9), Merkle Leaf count (Sec 10), and deterministic filler length (Sec 11).

returns.type: {magic: string, version: number, sectionCount: number, totalLen: number, rows: Array<{id: number, offset: number, len: number}>, storeIdHex: string|null, currentRootHex: string|null, keyTableCount: number, keyTable: Array<Object>, chunkPoolCount: number, merkleLeavesCount: number, metadata: Object|null, fillerLen: number}

symbols.complexity: O(s + k) time and O(s + k) space where s is section count and k is Section 8 key-table entry count.

symbols.name: compileAndParseDigsCapsule
symbols.signature: function compileAndParseDigsCapsule({ storeId, storeName = 'dbrain.to Store', generation = 1, resources = [] })
symbols.summary: Compiles, wraps in self-defending WebAssembly, and verifies a complete 13-section `DIGS\x01` capsule.
symbols.description: End-to-end Contract D8 capsule compiler: slices each resource into 64 KiB chunks, seals chunks with HKDF-derived `AES-256-GCM-SIV` keys, sorts entries lexicographically by provider-blind `staticKey32`, builds the Contract D8 binary Merkle tree + per-entry inclusion proofs, packs all 13 `DIGS\x01` binary sections, wraps the blob in a self-defending `\0asm` module, and self-verifies the output via `parseDigsBlob`.

params.name: params.storeName
params.description: Human-readable store label for Section 6 metadata.

params.name: params.resources
params.description: Plaintext resources to seal into the capsule.

returns.type: {storeIdHex: string, rootHex: string, programHash: string, digsBlobBuf: Buffer, wasmModuleBuf: Buffer, wasmValid: boolean, parsedDigs: Object, resourcesByRetrievalKey: Map<string, Object>}
returns.description: Compiled capsule artifacts and blind lookup index.

symbols.complexity: O(B + R log R) time and O(B) space where B is total resource bytes and R is `resources.length`.
symbols.example: const cap = compileAndParseDigsCapsule({ storeId: 'aa'.repeat(32), resources: [{ path: 'index.html', content: 'ok' }] });

symbols.name: buildBlindHostGetContentResponse
symbols.signature: function buildBlindHostGetContentResponse({ compiledCapsule, retrievalKeyHex, offset = 0, length = DIG_CHUNK_MAX_BYTES })
symbols.summary: Serves a provider-blind `dig.getContent` slice on hit or an indistinguishable deterministic decoy stream on miss.
symbols.description: Implements the provider-blind `dig.getContent` OpenRPC host response: when `retrievalKeyHex` exists in `compiledCapsule`, returns the requested byte-range slice and Base64 Merkle inclusion proof; on cache miss, synthesizes a deterministic 256-byte counter-mode SHA-256 decoy stream and structurally indistinguishable proof frame so external censors/scanners cannot probe URN presence.

params.name: params.offset
params.description: Zero-based byte offset into the resource ciphertext.

params.name: params.length
params.description: Requested maximum slice byte count (clamped to `[1, 1048576]`).

returns.type: {ciphertext: string, total_length: number, offset: number, length: number, complete: boolean, next_offset: number|null, inclusion_proof: string|null, chunk_lens: number[], root: string, program_hash: string}

symbols.complexity: O(L) time and O(L) space where L is the returned slice byte length.
symbols.example: const resp = buildBlindHostGetContentResponse({ compiledCapsule: cap, retrievalKeyHex: '00'.repeat(32) });

pillars.name: 5-Lobe Biological Taxonomy, Merkle KV Store & BQ-1024 LSH
pillars.purpose: Scaling agent memory from a handful of notes to millions of distributed capsules requires sub-linear candidate retrieval, low-bandwidth P2P gossip routing, and cryptographic state integrity. This module organizes memories into 5 biological lobes (`episodic`, `semantic`, `procedural`, `working`, `alignment`), computes deterministic L2-normalized embeddings, projects 1024-bit SimHash Binary Quantized (`BQ-1024`) signatures (`32 x u32` = `16 x u64`), extracts `16x16` Multi-Probe LSH bands and 16-lane MinHash shingle sketches, computes binary-reflected Gray-code locality ranks and 12-bit P2P canopy gossip topics, and builds Copy-on-Write-aware SHA-256 store Merkle roots and inclusion proofs.
invariants: Deterministic Cross-Node Embeddings: Identical normalized text always yields identical 8D float embeddings, `BQ-1024` bit-vectors, and `MinHash-16` signatures across every peer without external API calls.
Bounded Memory Footprint: Embedding (`256` entries) and Merkle leaf (`512` entries) LRU caches strictly evict least-recently-used keys so long-running agent daemons never leak heap memory.

Fork-Lineage Merkle Determinism: `resolveEffectiveStoreCapsules` replays ancestral Copy-on-Write forks in generation order, overrides duplicate `keyHex` slots with newer writes, and filters reverted tombstones before sorting lexicographically by `keyHex`.

subModules.title: Merkle-Pinned `10/10/10` Typed Cortical Ontologies & Zero-LLM Entity Resolution
subModules.purpose: Untyped knowledge graphs degrade into predicate soup (`RELATES_TO`, duplicate `"PostgresWalAdapter"` / `"the Postgres WAL adapter"` nodes, and invalid `(Person -> DEPENDS_ON -> Commit)` edges) that break multi-hop `CA3` triad completion. This sub-module enforces Merkle-pinned `10/10/10` cortical schemas (`<= 10` entity types, `<= 10` edge types, `<= 10` typed fields per type, and explicit `(sourceType -> targetType)` endpoint rules) plus zero-LLM `BQ-1024` + identifier-slug entity alias canonicalization.

subModules.title: Hybrid Semantic Random-Hyperplane Embedding Engine & Pluggable Neural Adapter
subModules.purpose: Cryptographic avalanche hashes like `SHA-256(lowercase(text))` destroy semantic locality: changing a single word or using a synonym (`"fix python null pointer crash"` vs. `"resolve NoneType exception failure in python"`) produces orthogonal vectors with near-zero cosine similarity. Conversely, requiring an external cloud embedding API or a 150 MB native ONNX runtime breaks air-gapped sovereignty and bloats container attack surfaces. This sub-module solves both constraints via a two-tier embedding architecture: 1. Zero-Dependency Offline Semantic Random-Hyperplane Projection (`computeSemanticEmbedding64`, `projectSemanticEmbedding8`, `computeSemanticSimHash1024`): Decomposes CamelCase/snake_case code identifiers, applies morphological stemming, maps ~45 software/security/ blockchain/civic synonym clusters into shared `concept:*` features, adds stem bigrams and character 3-grams, and projects weighted features onto 64 dense Johnson-Lindenstrauss hyperplanes + 1,024 Charikar SimHash bits in `< 0.2 ms` with zero external dependencies. 2. Pluggable Live Neural Embedding Adapter (`resolveNeuralOrHybridEmbedding`): Connects to live neural embedding endpoints (`Ollama`, `HuggingFace TEI`, `OpenAI` / `vLLM`, or `Google Gemini`) via `DBRAIN_EMBEDDING_URL` and projects arbitrary-dimension neural vectors (`384D..3072D`) into canonical `64D`, `8D`, and `BQ-1024` LSH representations with automatic offline fallback.

subModules.title: Asymmetric `32+32` Dual `BigInt` Specialization Bitmasks & Domain Classification (`DBRAIN-SPECIALIZATION-v1.0`)
subModules.purpose: General-purpose recall across hundreds or thousands of capsules suffers cross-domain lexical and LSH bucket collisions (`node`, `pool`, `state`, `tree` colliding across Three.js WebGL, Kubernetes StatefulSets, and Chia L1 Merkle trees). This Layer-1 sub-module implements `DBRAIN-SPECIALIZATION-v1.0`: hierarchical `spec:<domain>/<submode>` tags compiled into two `64-bit` `BigInt` bitmasks (`_specExactMask` + `_specSubtreeMask`) using a `32+32` hybrid layout (`bits 0..23` pinned core domains + `bits 24..31` reserved + `bits 32..63` 2-hash FNV-1a Bloom filter verified against exact string sets) for `O(1)` asymmetric ancestor-up / subtree-down candidate isolation with zero sibling bleed and zero `JSON.stringify` `BigInt` serialization errors.

symbols.name: SEMANTIC_STOPWORDS
symbols.summary: Stopword set filtered out prior to semantic feature extraction.
symbols.description: Low-information English function words excluded from unigram/bigram features so common filler words do not artificially inflate cosine similarity between unrelated technical memories.

symbols.name: SEMANTIC_CONCEPT_CLUSTERS
symbols.summary: Frozen array of canonical semantic equivalence clusters (`id` + `terms`).
symbols.description: Curated domain-spanning synonym equivalence clusters covering software engineering, cybersecurity, cryptography, Chia/Web3 primitives, AI cognition, databases, distributed systems, and civic governance. Every member term maps to a canonical `concept:<id>` feature so paraphrases collide in LSH space.

symbols.name: stemSemanticToken
symbols.summary: Reduces a lowercased alphanumeric token to its normalized morphological stem.
symbols.description: Lightweight deterministic English morphological stemmer that collapses common plural, gerund, past-tense, and nominalization suffixes so morphological variants (`verifying`, `verified`, `verification`) align onto shared stems.

returns.description: Stemmed token (minimum length 3 when input length >= 3).

symbols.complexity: O(k) time and O(k) space where k is `token.length`.

symbols.name: extractSemanticFeatures
symbols.summary: Extracts weighted multi-granularity semantic, morphological, and subword features from text.
symbols.description: Decomposes arbitrary text and code identifiers (`CamelCase`, `snake_case`, `kebab-case`, dotted paths) into weighted semantic features combining: - Canonical synonym concept clusters (`concept:<id>`, weight `3.2`) - Morphological stems (`stem:<w>`, weight `2.0`) - Exact compound code identifiers (`id:<ident>`, weight `1.8`) - Ordered stem bigrams (`bi:<s1>_<s2>`, weight `1.2`) - Character 3-gram subwords (`g3:<tri>`, weight `0.35`)
symbols.complexity: O(L) time and O(F) space where L is `text.length` and F <= L is unique feature count.
symbols.example: const feats = extractSemanticFeatures('resolve NoneType crash in _arithmetic_mask');

symbols.name: computeSemanticEmbedding64
symbols.summary: Computes an L2-normalized 64D semantic random-hyperplane embedding vector offline in `< 0.2 ms`.
symbols.description: Projects arbitrary UTF-8 text into a deterministic, L2-normalized 64-dimensional semantic vector in `[-1, 1]^64` via Johnson-Lindenstrauss random-hyperplane projection (`SHA-512(feature)` signed byte weights summed across all semantic concept, stem, identifier, bigram, and character 3-gram features).

params.name: text
params.description: Input text or code snippet to embed.

returns.description: 64-element unit-norm floating-point embedding array rounded to 4 decimal places.

symbols.complexity: O(L) time and O(1) output space (64 floats) where L is `text.length`.
symbols.example: const v64 = computeSemanticEmbedding64('fix python null pointer crash'); // length 64

symbols.name: projectDenseVectorToDim
symbols.summary: Block-pools and L2-normalizes a dense float vector to `targetDim` dimensions (default `8D`).
symbols.description: Folds an arbitrary-dimension dense embedding vector (`64D`, `384D`, `768D`, `1536D`, etc.) into a compact `targetDim`-dimensional L2-normalized vector via uniform block-sum pooling, preserving backward-compatible `8D` capsule `embeddingPreview` fields while retaining genuine semantic locality.

returns.description: L2-normalized `targetDim`-element float array rounded to 4 decimal places.

symbols.complexity: O(D) time and O(targetDim) space where D is `denseVec.length`.

symbols.name: computeSemanticSimHash1024
symbols.summary: Computes a 1,024-bit weighted Semantic SimHash (`BQ-1024`, `32 x u32`) over concept & subword features.
symbols.description: Projects arbitrary text into a 1,024-bit Charikar Semantic SimHash Binary Quantized (`BQ-1024`) signature (`32 x u32` = `128` bytes) over weighted semantic concept clusters, morphological stems, compound code symbols, stem bigrams, and character 3-grams so synonyms and paraphrases collide across Multi-Probe LSH bands without external neural models.

params.name: text
params.description: Input document or query text to quantize.

returns.description: 32-element unsigned 32-bit integer array representing 1,024 hyperplane sign bits.

symbols.complexity: O(L) time and O(1) output space (`32 x u32`) where L is `text.length`.

symbols.summary: Quantizes a dense neural float embedding vector into a 1,024-bit `BQ-1024` (`32 x u32`) LSH signature.
symbols.description: Quantizes any dense neural float vector (`384D`, `768D`, `1536D`, `3072D`) into a deterministic 1,024-bit `BQ-1024` signature (`32 x u32`) using seeded Rademacher random-hyperplane projections so external neural embeddings index directly into `dbrain`'s 16-band Multi-Probe LSH tables.

params.name: denseVec
params.description: Arbitrary-length dense floating-point vector from a neural embedding model.

returns.description: 32-element unsigned 32-bit integer array (`1,024` hyperplane sign bits).

symbols.complexity: O(D) time and O(1) space where D is `denseVec.length`.

symbols.name: resolveNeuralOrHybridEmbedding
symbols.summary: Computes neural or hybrid semantic embeddings (`64D`, `8D`, `BQ-1024`) via pluggable HTTP provider or offline kernel.
symbols.description: Resolves embeddings through a live neural HTTP provider (`ollama`, `tei`, `openai`, or `gemini`) when `endpointUrl` / `DBRAIN_EMBEDDING_URL` is set, or deterministically via the offline `local-simhash-64d` engine when unconfigured (or as an automatic fault-tolerant fallback unless `strictNeural: true`).

symbols.name: classifyCapsuleSpecializationsDeterministic
symbols.summary: Classifies a capsule into canonical `spec:*` tags with zero LLM calls.
symbols.description: Deterministically classifies a capsule into canonical `spec:*` specialization tags in `< 0.08 ms` with zero LLM calls: honors explicit `spec:*` entries in `capsule.specializations` / `capsule.tags` first, otherwise scores the 23 domain-odor signatures (`OR-SPEC-01..08`) and defaults general rules to `['spec:universal']`.
symbols.complexity: O(L) over capsule text/metadata length `L`.
symbols.example: const specs = classifyCapsuleSpecializationsDeterministic({ title: 'Fix dao_escrow puzzle', filePaths: ['a.clsp'] });

symbols.name: compileCapsuleSpecializationMasks
symbols.summary: Compiles dual 64-bit `exactMask64` and `subtreeMask64` `BigInt` masks for a capsule.
symbols.description: Compiles a capsule (or explicit tag array) into its canonical `effectiveSpecializations` plus dual 64-bit `BigInt` bitmasks (`exactMask64` for leaf/ancestor queries and `subtreeMask64` for parent/subtree queries).

params.name: capsuleOrSpecs
params.description: Capsule object or explicit specialization tag list.

returns.type: { effectiveSpecializations: string[], exactMask64: bigint, subtreeMask64: bigint, exactMaskHex: string, subtreeMaskHex: string, hasBloomBits: boolean }
returns.description: Compiled specialization masks and hex representations.

symbols.complexity: O(S) where `S <= 8` is specialization tag count.

symbols.name: attachCapsuleSpecializationMetadata
symbols.summary: Hydrates enumerable `effectiveSpecializations` and non-enumerable `BigInt` masks onto a capsule.
symbols.description: Attaches `effectiveSpecializations` (enumerable) and `_specExactMask`, `_specSubtreeMask`, `_specHasBloom` (**non-enumerable** so `JSON.stringify` never serializes `BigInt`) onto a hydrated capsule object.

params.name: capsule
params.description: Target capsule object to hydrate in place.

params.name: overrideSpecs
params.description: Optional off-leaf sidecar specialization override list.

symbols.complexity: O(S) where `S <= 8` is specialization count.

symbols.name: compileQuerySpecializationFilter
symbols.summary: Compiles query specialization strings into `O(1)` asymmetric `BigInt` filter masks.
symbols.description: Compiles an agent's active specialization query filter into `exactCheckMask` and `subtreeCheckMask` `BigInt` bitmasks implementing asymmetric matching: - Leaf query (`spec:chia/dao`): checks `exactCheckMask` (`universal | chia | chia/dao`). - Parent/wildcard query (`spec:chia` or `spec:chia/*`): also checks `subtreeCheckMask` (`chia`).

returns.type: { unconstrained: boolean, specs: string[], exactCheckMask: bigint, subtreeCheckMask: bigint, hasBloomTerms: boolean, parsedRules: Array<{rawNormalized: string, baseTag: string, isSubtree: boolean}>, cacheKey: string }

symbols.complexity: O(Q) where Q is requested specialization count.

symbols.name: matchesSpecializationFilter
symbols.summary: Evaluates Stage-0 specialization visibility for a candidate capsule.
symbols.description: Evaluates whether a candidate capsule is visible under an active specialization filter in `O(1)` bitwise time (`alignment` lobe & `spec:universal` always pass; Bloom hits in `bits 32..63` undergo exact string verification for `0%` false positives).

params.name: filterOrRawSpecs
params.description: Compiled filter or raw specialization token(s).

returns.description: `true` when the capsule is admitted into the recall candidate pool.

symbols.complexity: O(1) bitwise AND + optional `<= 4`-element string verification on Bloom tags.
symbols.example: const visible = matchesSpecializationFilter({ lobe: 'alignment', title: 'Guard' }, ['spec:ui/webgl']); // true

symbols.name: isSpecializationSubsetOfCeiling
symbols.summary: Verifies that requested specializations narrow (never widen) a lease ceiling.
symbols.description: Validates that `requestedSpecs` is a non-widening subset/narrowing of an Alignment Lease's `ceilingSpecs` (`'*'` ceiling permits all valid specs; a constrained ceiling blocks `'*'`, unrelated siblings, parent widening, and unauthorized `spec:universal` writes).

params.name: requestedSpecs
params.description: Requested specialization focus or write tags.

returns.type: { allowed: boolean, effectiveSpecs: string[], reason: string }

symbols.complexity: O(R * C) where R and C are rule counts (`<= 8`).

symbols.name: VALID_LOBES
symbols.summary: Set of the 5 canonical biological cognitive lobe identifiers.
symbols.description: Immutable Set of the 5 canonical biological cognitive lobes recognized by `DBRAIN-v1.3` (`'episodic'`, `'semantic'`, `'procedural'`, `'working'`, `'alignment'`).

symbols.name: DBRAIN_CANONICAL_PROTOCOL
symbols.summary: Canonical `DBRAIN-v1.3` wire protocol version string.
symbols.description: Canonical protocol version identifier (`'DBRAIN-v1.3'`) stamped onto all newly minted capsules, VCS commits, and recall envelopes.

symbols.name: LEGACY_PROTOCOL_ALIASES
symbols.summary: Set of legacy `DBRAIN-*` and `DIG-BRAIN-*` protocol version aliases.
symbols.description: Recognized historical protocol version strings (`DBRAIN-v1.0`..`v1.2` and `DIG-BRAIN-v1.0`..`v1.2`) that transparently upgrade to `DBRAIN-v1.3`.

symbols.name: normalizeDbrainProtocol
symbols.summary: Normalizes protocol strings to `'DBRAIN-v1.3'` and transparently upgrades legacy aliases.
symbols.description: Validates a protocol version string against `DBRAIN-v1.3`, transparently upgrading recognized legacy `DBRAIN-v1.*` and `DIG-BRAIN-v1.*` envelopes while flagging unknown strings as invalid.

params.name: rawProtocol
params.description: Incoming protocol identifier from a capsule or RPC envelope.

returns.type: {valid: boolean, protocol: string, upgradedFromLegacy: boolean, originalProtocol: string}

symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.
symbols.example: const info = normalizeDbrainProtocol('DIG-BRAIN-v1.1'); // { valid: true, upgradedFromLegacy: true, ... }

symbols.name: computeDeterministicEmbedding
symbols.summary: Computes an L2-normalized 8D deterministic semantic embedding vector with bounded LRU memoization.
symbols.description: Projects arbitrary UTF-8 text into a deterministic, L2-normalized 8-dimensional semantic floating-point vector in `[-1, 1]^8` by computing the 64D semantic concept/stem/subword random-hyperplane projection (`computeSemanticEmbedding64`), block-pooling onto 8 principal coordinates, and memoizing inside a 256-slot LRU cache.

returns.description: 8-element unit-norm floating-point embedding array rounded to 4 decimal places.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time on cache miss (where n is `text.length`), O(1) time on LRU cache hit; O(1) space.

symbols.name: computeCapsuleLeafHashHex
symbols.summary: Computes a memoized SHA-256 Merkle leaf hex digest for `(keyHex, contentHash)`.
symbols.description: Computes and memoizes the 64-character lowercase SHA-256 leaf digest `SHA-256("${keyHex}:${contentHash}")` binding a capsule's DataLayer key to its content digest inside a 512-entry LRU cache.

params.name: keyHex
params.description: Hexadecimal DataLayer key of the capsule.

params.name: contentHash
params.description: `0x`-prefixed SHA-256 content hash of the capsule payload.

symbols.complexity: O(k) time on cache miss (where k is `keyHex.length`), O(1) on LRU cache hit; O(1) space.

symbols.name: getDbrainCoreCacheStats
symbols.summary: Returns live hit/miss and occupancy telemetry for core embedding and Merkle LRU caches.
symbols.description: Returns live occupancy, capacity, hit count, and miss count telemetry for both `embeddingLruCache` and `merkleLeafLruCache`.

returns.type: {embeddingCache: {size: number, maxEntries: number, hits: number, misses: number}, merkleLeafCache: {size: number, maxEntries: number, hits: number, misses: number}}

symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: cosineSimilarity
symbols.summary: Computes cosine similarity in `[-1, 1]` between two equal-length numeric vectors.
symbols.description: Computes the cosine similarity `(a · b) / (||a|| * ||b||)` in `[-1, 1]` between two equal-length numeric vectors, returning `0` safely for empty, mismatched, or zero-norm inputs.

returns.description: Cosine similarity score in `[-1, 1]`, or `0` if invalid/zero-magnitude.

symbols.complexity: O(d) time and O(1) space where d is vector dimensionality (`a.length`).

symbols.name: computeBinaryQuantizedEmbedding1024
symbols.summary: Projects text into a 1024-bit Semantic SimHash Binary Quantized (`BQ-1024`) signature (`32 x u32`).
symbols.description: Projects arbitrary text into a 1024-bit Semantic SimHash Binary Quantized (`BQ-1024`) hyperplane sign signature (`32 x u32` = `16 x u64` = `128` bytes) over weighted synonym concept clusters, morphological stems, code identifiers, stem bigrams, and character 3-gram subwords via `computeSemanticSimHash1024`.

params.name: text
params.description: Input document or query text to quantize.

returns.description: 32-element unsigned 32-bit integer array representing 1024 quantized bits.

symbols.complexity: O(L) time and O(1) auxiliary space where L is `text.length`.

symbols.name: computeBqHammingSimilarity1024
symbols.summary: Computes normalized bitwise Hamming similarity in `[0, 1]` between two `BQ-1024` signatures.
symbols.description: Computes the normalized bitwise Hamming similarity `1 - POPCNT(sigA XOR sigB) / 1024` in `[0, 1]` between two 32-word `BQ-1024` signatures using branchless SWAR (SIMD-Within-A-Register) 32-bit population count arithmetic.

returns.description: Normalized Hamming similarity in `[0, 1]` rounded to 4 decimal places.

symbols.complexity: O(1) time (32 branchless SWAR word XOR + popcount steps) and O(1) space.

symbols.name: extractLshBands16x16
symbols.summary: Extracts `L = 16` Multi-Probe LSH band bucket keys from a `BQ-1024` signature.
symbols.description: Slices `L = 16` locality-sensitive hash band keys (masked to 10-bit bucket IDs `0..1023` within each 16-bit band slot) from the first 16 words of a `BQ-1024` signature so single-bit neighbor probes stay compact and cache-resident.

returns.description: 16-element array of unsigned LSH band bucket keys (`0..1023`).

symbols.complexity: O(1) time (16 bitmask operations) and O(1) space.

symbols.name: computeMinHashSignature16
symbols.summary: Computes a 16-lane 32-bit MinHash shingle signature for unbiased Jaccard estimation.
symbols.description: Computes a 16-lane 32-bit MinHash signature over normalized lexical tokens: derives two independent 32-bit SHA-256 seeds `(h1, odd h2)` per token and tracks the minimum rotated universal hash `rotl32((k + 1) * h2 + h1, (k & 15) + 1)` across `k = 0..15` lanes for unbiased Jaccard set-overlap estimation.

returns.description: 16-element array of minimum unsigned 32-bit lane hashes.

symbols.complexity: O(T) time and O(1) auxiliary space where T is token count (`16 * T` lane updates).
symbols.example: const mh16 = computeMinHashSignature16('merkle inclusion proof'); // length 16

symbols.name: computeMinHashJaccard16
symbols.summary: Computes the estimated Jaccard similarity in `[0, 1]` between two `MinHash-16` signatures.
symbols.description: Estimates the token-set Jaccard similarity `|A ∩ B| / |A ∪ B|` in `[0, 1]` as the fraction of identical 32-bit lanes (`matches / 16`) between two `MinHash-16` signatures.

returns.description: Estimated Jaccard similarity in `[0, 1]` rounded to 4 decimal places.

symbols.complexity: O(1) time (16 integer comparisons) and O(1) space.

symbols.name: computeLshGrayCodeRank
symbols.summary: Computes a 32-bit binary-reflected Gray-code LSH locality rank (`b ^ (b >>> 1)`).
symbols.description: Folds the top 3 words of a `BQ-1024` signature into a 32-bit binary-reflected Gray-code ordering key `g = w0 ^ (w0 >>> 1)` so semantically adjacent capsules sort next to each other inside `k = 32` Beneš factoradic leaf blocks.
symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: computeLshCanopyTopic
symbols.summary: Computes a 12-bit P2P LSH canopy topic (`0x000..0xfff`) and single-bit neighbor channels.
symbols.description: Projects a `BQ-1024` signature onto a 12-bit P2P gossip canopy channel (`0x000`..`0xfff`, 4,096 total topics) and derives three single-bit Hamming neighbor channels (`^ 0x001`, `^ 0x010`, `^ 0x100`) so swarm peers subscribe to only 4 channels while pruning 91.4% of irrelevant WAN gossip traffic.

returns.type: {canopyTopicId: number, canopyTopicHex: string, multiProbeNeighborTopics: string[], totalCanopyChannels: number, subscribedChannelsPerPeer: number, wanGossipSavedPct: number}

symbols.complexity: O(1) time and O(1) space.

symbols.name: buildMultiProbeLshIndex
symbols.summary: Builds a 16-band Multi-Probe LSH inverted hash table over a capsule corpus.
symbols.description: Indexes an array of cognitive capsules into 16 independent Multi-Probe LSH band hash tables (`bandTables[0..15]`), precomputing each capsule's `BQ-1024` bit-vector, `MinHash-16` shingle sketch, Gray-code locality rank, and 12-bit P2P canopy topic.

params.name: capsules
params.description: Array of raw cognitive capsule objects to index.

returns.type: {protocol: string, bandCount: number, bitsPerBand: number, totalSignatureBits: number, totalIndexed: number, bandTables: Array<Map<number, number[]>>, indexedCapsules: Array<Object>}

symbols.complexity: O(N * L) time and O(N) space where N is `capsules.length` and L is average capsule text length.
symbols.example: const idx = buildMultiProbeLshIndex([{ id: 'CAP-1', title: 'Merkle tree', content: 'SHA-256' }]);

symbols.name: queryMultiProbeLshIndex
symbols.signature: function queryMultiProbeLshIndex(lshIndex, queryText, { enableOneBitProbes = true, topK = 5 } = {})
symbols.summary: Executes a sub-linear Multi-Probe LSH query and re-ranks candidates by `BQ-1024 + MinHash-16`.
symbols.description: Queries a 16-band Multi-Probe LSH index in sub-linear time: probes each band's exact 10-bit bucket (weight `3`) plus optionally all 10 single-bit Hamming neighbor buckets (`baseKey ^ (1 << bit)`, weight `1` -> `16 * 11 = 176` probes), then re-ranks only the colliding candidate subset via `0.65 * BQ-1024 + 0.35 * MinHash-16`.

params.name: options.enableOneBitProbes
params.description: Probe 10 single-bit flipped neighbor buckets per band in addition to exact bucket.

returns.type: {protocol: string, totalIndexed: number, bucketProbesExecuted: number, candidatesEvaluated: number, linearScanComparisonsAvoided: number, candidatePruningPct: number, results: Array<Object>}
returns.description: Ranked LSH recall results and pruning telemetry.

symbols.complexity: O(P + C) time where P <= 176 hash probes and C << N is colliding candidate count; O(C) space.

symbols.name: resolveEffectiveStoreCapsules
symbols.signature: function resolveEffectiveStoreCapsules(storeId, capsules = [], maxGeneration = null, stores = [])
symbols.summary: Resolves active capsules for `storeId` across Copy-on-Write fork lineage and revert tombstones.
symbols.description: Resolves the effective set of active capsules for a `storeId` at an optional `maxGeneration` ceiling: walks backwards up any Copy-on-Write `forkedFromStoreId` chain, replays ancestor-to-descendant generations in chronological order (so child writes cleanly shadow parent `keyHex` entries), excludes capsules reverted on or before `maxGeneration`, and returns the active set sorted lexicographically by `keyHex`.

params.name: maxGeneration
params.description: Optional historical generation ceiling (`null` = latest HEAD).

symbols.complexity: O(F + C log C) time and O(C) space where F is fork chain depth and C is matching capsule count.

symbols.name: computeStoreMerkleRoot
symbols.signature: function computeStoreMerkleRoot(storeId, capsules = [], maxGeneration = null, stores = [])
symbols.summary: Computes the deterministic `0x`-prefixed SHA-256 Merkle root of a store at a given generation.
symbols.description: Computes the deterministic `0x`-prefixed 32-byte SHA-256 Merkle root over all active capsules in `storeId` (at `maxGeneration` or HEAD), returning `SHA-256("genesis:" + storeId)` when the store has zero active capsules and duplicating odd trailing leaves during pairwise bottom-up reduction.

params.name: maxGeneration
params.description: Optional generation ceiling (`null` for current HEAD).

params.name: stores
params.description: Optional store lineage descriptors for Copy-on-Write forks.

symbols.complexity: O(C log C) time and O(C) space where C is active capsule count in the store.

symbols.name: computeMerkleInclusionProof
symbols.summary: Generates and verifies a binary SHA-256 Merkle inclusion proof and sibling path for a capsule.
symbols.description: Generates and self-verifies a SHA-256 binary Merkle inclusion proof (`siblingPath` with `'left'` / `'right'` positional tags) for a specific `capsule` inside its store, comparing the folded `computedMerkleRoot` against `capsule.merkleRoot`.

params.name: capsule
params.description: Target capsule object (`{ id, storeId, key, keyHex, contentHash, merkleRoot }`).

params.name: stores
params.description: Optional store descriptors for Copy-on-Write fork lineage.

returns.type: {capsuleId: string, storeId: string, key: string, keyHex: string, contentHash: string, leafHash: string, computedMerkleRoot: string, recordedMerkleRoot: string, siblingPath: Array<{position: string, hash: string}>, treeDepth: number, totalStoreLeaves: number, verified: boolean}

symbols.complexity: O(C log C) time and O(C) space where C is active capsule count in `capsule.storeId`.

symbols.name: ENCODING_TASK_PHASES
symbols.summary: Frozen 5-bit task-phase bitmask dictionary for Tulving Encoding Specificity cues.
symbols.description: Canonical 5-bit cognitive task-phase bitmask constants implementing Tulving's Encoding Specificity Principle (`0x01..0x10`) in a single byte with zero LLM calls.
symbols.valueType: Readonly<{PLANNING: number, DEBUGGING: number, SECURITY_AUDIT: number, DEPLOYMENT: number, GOVERNANCE: number}>

symbols.name: extractEncodingSpecificityCue
symbols.summary: Extracts a 5-bit task-phase bitmask and spatial Entorhinal `placeGrid` cue without LLM latency.
symbols.description: Extracts a deterministic Tulving Encoding Specificity cue (`phaseMask`, `activePhases`) and Entorhinal `placeGrid` (`repo`, `pathPrefix`, `network`, `branch`) from either a capsule at mint/hydration time or an agent's active retrieval query in `< 0.01 ms`.

returns.type: {phaseMask: number, activePhases: string[], placeGrid: {repo: string, pathPrefix: string, network: string, branch: string}}

symbols.complexity: O(L) single linear pass over input text length `L`.
symbols.example: const cue = extractEncodingSpecificityCue({ query: 'Fix deadlock bug in k8s rollout', repo: 'dcarrith/dbrain' });

symbols.name: computeEncodingSpecificityBoost
symbols.summary: Scores encoding-vs-retrieval task-phase and spatial `placeGrid` alignment in `[-0.04, 0.15]`.
symbols.description: Computes Tulving's Encoding Specificity retrieval boost by comparing the 5-bit cognitive `phaseMask` (`AND` + popcount Jaccard) and Entorhinal `placeGrid` coordinates encoded at memory formation against the active retrieval context.

params.name: encodingCue
params.description: Cue stamped on or hydrated from the stored capsule.

params.name: retrievalCue
params.description: Cue extracted from the live agent query context.

returns.type: {boost: number, matchedPhaseMask: number, phaseOverlapRatio: number, placeMatches: string[]}

symbols.complexity: O(1) bitwise operations and 4 string coordinate checks.

symbols.name: extractDentateScopeFacets
symbols.summary: Extracts version, environment, and directive-polarity facets for Dentate Gyrus pattern separation.
symbols.description: Extracts Dentate Gyrus (`DG`) orthogonal scope discriminators (`versions`, `environment`, `polarity`) so lexically near-identical capsules (`v1` vs `v2`, `testnet` vs `production`) map to separated representations instead of colliding.
symbols.complexity: O(L) single regex scan over input text.
symbols.example: const facets = extractDentateScopeFacets({ title: 'API v2 production auth guardrail: never log tokens' });

symbols.name: computeDentatePatternSeparation
symbols.summary: Computes Dentate Gyrus contrastive scope separation delta in `[-0.24, 0.10]`.
symbols.description: Applies hippocampal Dentate Gyrus (`DG`) contrastive pattern separation between query scope facets and candidate capsule facets, rewarding exact version/environment alignment (`+0.05` / `+0.03`) while penalizing near-miss version (`-0.14`) or environment (`-0.12`) collisions that cause cross-version agent hallucinations.

params.name: queryFacets
params.description: Scope facets extracted from the query.

params.name: docFacets
params.description: Scope facets extracted from the candidate capsule.

returns.type: {delta: number, exactVersionMatch: boolean, versionCollision: boolean, environmentCollision: boolean}

symbols.complexity: O(V) where `V` is the count of distinct version tokens (typically `<= 3`).
symbols.example: const sep = computeDentatePatternSeparation({ versions: ['v2'], environment: 'production' }, { versions: ['v1'], environment: 'production' });

symbols.name: normalizeSimLineage
symbols.summary: Normalizes `SIM` cross-model lineage metadata (`problemClusterId`, `rationale`, `scopeKind`, `sourceModelFamily`).
symbols.description: Normalizes a `SIM` (`arXiv:2611.18856` Self-Improvement Memory) cross-model lineage descriptor grouping capsule/harness edits by recurring problem cluster.

params.name: fallbackText
params.description: Optional title/content fallback used to hash `problemClusterId`.

returns.description: Normalized frozen `simLineage` block, or `null` when absent.

symbols.complexity: O(L) where L is rationale/fallback text length.
symbols.example: const sim = normalizeSimLineage({ rationale: 'Fix JSON quote escape', sourceModelFamily: 'qwen', scopeKind: 'model_quirk' });

symbols.name: evaluateDentateIffPrecondition
symbols.summary: Evaluates whether query/session context satisfies a capsule's `[iff]` precondition guard.
symbols.description: Evaluates a `GUARD` `[iff <condition>]` Dentate precondition guard (`#2`) against query/session execution metadata so out-of-scope capsules can be deterministically hard-filtered before entering prompt context.

returns.type: { matched: boolean, guarded: boolean, reason: string }

symbols.complexity: O(G) where G is guard token count (`<= 8`).
symbols.example: const ok = evaluateDentateIffPrecondition({ runtime: 'python' }, { requiredRuntimes: ['python'] }); // { matched: true, guarded: true, ... }

symbols.name: synthesizeDentateIffScopeRepair
symbols.summary: Synthesizes a discriminative `dentateFacets.iff` precondition separating `helpedTasks` from `hurtTasks`.
symbols.description: Synthesizes an in-round `GUARD` `[iff <condition>]` Dentate scope guard (`arXiv:2611.23476` §4.4) when a candidate capsule improves `helpedTasks` while causing isolated regressions on `hurtTasks` by over-triggering outside its discriminative runtime, environment, tool, or error context.

params.name: params.helpedTasks
params.description: Replay tasks improved by the candidate.

params.name: params.hurtTasks
params.description: Replay tasks regressed by the candidate.

returns.type: { repaired: boolean, iffGuard: Object|null, repairedCapsule: Object }

symbols.complexity: O(H + R) where H and R are `helpedTasks.length` and `hurtTasks.length`.
symbols.example: const rep = synthesizeDentateIffScopeRepair({ candidateCapsule: { title: 'Async retry' }, helpedTasks: [{ runtime: 'python' }], hurtTasks: [{ runtime: 'rust' }] });

pillars.name: Hybrid 4-Signal Recall (SWE-ContextBench) & KV Delta Sync
pillars.purpose: Pure dense-vector RAG struggles on exact code identifiers (`_arithmetic_mask`), while pure keyword search misses semantically equivalent architectural notes and neither verifies cryptographic provenance. This module fuses 4 orthogonal signals in sub-millisecond time — (1) LSH + Cosine semantic similarity, (2) BM25 lexical + AST symbol/path overlap, (3) Subject-Predicate-Object (`SPO`) knowledge-graph triple matching, and (4) parent Merkle root lineage verification — alongside Chia DataLayer `get_kv_diff` (`hash1 -> hash2`) delta synchronization so agent swarms exchange only changed capsules instead of resending 400 KiB+ full-context windows.
invariants: Bounded Composite Score (`<= 0.998`): Weighted fusion (`0.25 * semantic + 0.40 * bm25Symbol + 0.20 * spoGraph + 0.15 * merkleLineage`) stays strictly normalized in `[0, 0.998]` for calibrated confidence gating.
Sub-Linear Candidate Pruning: When `invertedIndex` is supplied, full 4-signal scoring evaluates at most `candidateLimit` top hit-weighted docs.
Tombstone-Clean Delta Sync: `computeMerkleKvDiff` excludes reverted commits and binds exact `hash1` (`fromGeneration`) and `hash2` (`toGeneration`) roots.

subModules.title: @dbrain/core/pillars/pillar04/ast-bm25f-ranker
subModules.purpose: Naive `.includes()` substring scoring fails on real-world software engineering benchmarks (`SWE-ContextBench` Lite & Full, `LoCoMo` Open-Domain) for three mathematical reasons: 1. Short tokens (`"in"`, `"id"`, `"add"`, `"set"`) match inside unrelated words (`"join"`, `"valid"`, `"padding"`, `"offset"`), while common mono-repo words (`"django"`, `"models"`, `"query"`) drown out rare bug-locus AST symbols. 2. Diff-only tasks (`707 / 1,007` in `SWE-ContextBench Full`) lack runtime call traces, causing static linear weights to suffer dead-weight range compression. 3. Indirect multi-file bugs report a symptom in caller `A` while the root-cause patch lives 1–2 hops away in callee `B`. This sub-module provides: - Hierarchical AST identifier decomposition (`Class.method`, `CamelCase`, `snake_case`) and strict 3-tier symbol matching (zero accidental inner-word substring hits), - Fielded Okapi BM25F (`k1 = 1.5, b = 0.75`) with Robertson-Sparck Jones corpus IDF, - 2-Hop Damped Personalized PageRank (`PPR`, `alpha = 0.85`) over unified `BPC1` call-graph, `SPO` triples, `[[wikilinks]]`, and module-directory adjacency, and - Query-Adaptive Missing-Modality Renormalization + 3-Channel Reciprocal Rank Fusion (`RRF`).

subModules.title: Zero-LLM Declarative Cortical Context Template Compiler (`%{entities}` / `%{edges}`)
subModules.purpose: Raw JSON memory dumps waste agent prompt tokens and bury typed graph relationships in noise, while calling an LLM to summarize context on every turn adds `300-800 ms` latency. This sub-module compiles declarative `%{entities ...}`, `%{edges ...}`, `%{antibodies ...}`, and `%{memories ...}` interpolation blocks directly from typed cortical capsules inside a strict token ceiling (`<= 512` tokens by default) with zero LLM invocations.

subModules.title: 4-Layer LLM Inference Cache Optimizer (KV Projection, vLLM/LMCache Prefix & Guarded Semantic Equivalence)
subModules.purpose: Modern LLM serving stacks operate across 4 (+1) distinct cache layers: 1. KV Cache (single-request decode, HBM memory-bandwidth bound) 2. Prefix Cache (self-hosted vLLM/SGLang 16-token hash chains & LMCache CacheBlend) 3. Prompt Cache (provider-billed 0.1x read vs 1.25x write prefix breakpoints) 4. Semantic Cache (fuzzy embedding response lookup — NOT correctness-neutral!) 5. Exact-Match Response Cache (byte-identical canonical request + state digest) This zero-dependency sub-module equips `@dbrain/core` with deterministic primitives maximizing every cache layer: - `projectCapsuleForLlmContext`: Strips non-reasoning `_searchHaystack`, `embedding64`, and multi-kilobyte `wotsPlusSignatureB64Url` blobs from MCP recall payloads (`~5.5x` smaller GPU HBM KV-cache footprint per decode step). - `derivePrefixCacheSalt`: Maps Pillar 6 Private Cortex custody modes onto vLLM's per-tenant `block_hashes(token_ids, salt)` (`null` for public `.dig` commons; HMAC-SHA256 enclave salt for private stores to prevent TTFT timing side-channel leaks). - `compilePrefixCacheAlignedContext`: Emits `LMCache` (`CacheBlend`) chunk delimiters (`<!-- dbrain:lmcache:chunk:start -->`) and 16-token block alignment so reordered `.dig` capsules achieve `2-3x` TTFT reuse. - `evaluateSemanticCacheEquivalence`: Eliminates all 3 fatal semantic-cache HTTP-200 failure modes (negation blindness `0.952`, operational value swaps `0.887`, and missing prior conversational turn) using zero-RTT local 64D embeddings + Dentate polarity/version/numeric/token parity guards.

pillars.name: Git for Agent Memories (DBRAIN-v1.3 Cognitive VCS)
pillars.purpose: Traditional agent vector databases overwrite rows in place: if a background subagent hallucinates or ingests prompt-injected context, canonical facts are silently corrupted with no audit trail or rollback path. This module brings full Git semantics to agent cognition (`DBRAIN-v1.3`): deterministic SHA-256 commit chains (`dbrain commit`), `BPC1` factoradic + `CHIP-0028` Clear Sign + hybrid Post-Quantum (`ML-DSA-65 + Ed25519`) capsule extensions, `O(1)` 0-byte Copy-on-Write branch forks (`dbrain fork`), verified historical time-travel snapshots (`dbrain checkout`), non-destructive tombstoning (`dbrain revert`), 3-way Subject-Predicate-Object (`SPO`) epistemic merges gated by a Cognitive Canary threshold (`dbrain merge`), and `O(log N)` binary search regression isolation (`dbrain bisect`).
invariants: Append-Only Non-Destructive History: `revertCognitiveGeneration` never deletes historical records; it stamps `revertedByCommitSha` and `revertedAtGeneration` and advances `store.generation` by `+1`.
Zero-Copy Subagent Isolation: `forkStoreZeroCopy` copies `0` capsule payload bytes, inheriting parent `merkleRoot` and `generation` via pointer.

Canary-Gated Epistemic Merge: `mergeCognitiveBranches` refuses to mark `merged: true` unless `simulatedCanaryScore >= canaryThreshold` AND any conflicting `SPO` triples are resolved via `crdt-lww` or `quarantine`.

pillars.name: Zero-Knowledge Private Cortex Encryption (AES-256-GCM)
pillars.purpose: While public skills and shared entity graphs thrive on open P2P replication, personal daily logs, proprietary credentials, and unmerged Working Lobe hypotheses must remain completely opaque to storage mirrors and unauthorized peers. This module implements a zero-knowledge Private Cortex enclave using RFC 5869 `HKDF-SHA256` key derivation and `AES-256-GCM` authenticated encryption with Additional Authenticated Data (`AAD`) context binding so sealed capsules cannot be decrypted or replayed across mismatched stores, lobes, or protocol versions.
invariants: Per-Envelope Cryptographic Freshness: Every `sealPrivateCortexAesGcm` invocation draws a fresh 128-bit CSPRNG HKDF salt and a fresh 96-bit CSPRNG GCM initialization vector (`iv`).

Contextual AAD Binding: `aadStr` (e.g., `'dbrain:cortex:v1.2'` or a store/DID scope) is cryptographically bound into the 128-bit GCM authentication tag; substituting a different `expectedAadStr` during `openPrivateCortexAesGcm` causes `decipher.final()` to throw before any plaintext JSON is parsed.

symbols.name: sealPrivateCortexAesGcm
symbols.summary: Seals a JSON payload using `HKDF-SHA256` + `AES-256-GCM` with `AAD` context binding.
symbols.description: Seals an arbitrary JSON-serializable cognitive payload inside a zero-knowledge Private Cortex envelope: draws a fresh 16-byte CSPRNG salt and 12-byte GCM IV, derives a dedicated 256-bit key via `HKDF-SHA256` (`info = 'dbrain-cortex-aes256gcm'`), binds `aadStr` as Additional Authenticated Data, and encrypts the UTF-8 JSON bytes under `AES-256-GCM`.

params.name: payloadObj
params.description: Arbitrary JSON-serializable cognitive state object to encrypt.

params.name: secretKeyMaterial
params.description: High-entropy operator or swarm master secret key material.

params.name: aadStr
params.description: Unencrypted context string cryptographically bound to the GCM tag.

returns.type: {protocol: string, aad: string, saltHex: string, ivHex: string, authTagHex: string, ciphertextBase64: string}

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space where n is the serialized UTF-8 JSON byte length of `payloadObj`.

symbols.name: openPrivateCortexAesGcm
symbols.summary: Authenticates `AAD` + GCM tag and decrypts a Private Cortex `AES-256-GCM` envelope back to JSON.
symbols.description: Authenticates and decrypts a Private Cortex `AES-256-GCM` envelope produced by `sealPrivateCortexAesGcm`: re-derives the 32-byte `HKDF-SHA256` key from `secretKeyMaterial` and `envelopeObj.saltHex`, verifies both `expectedAadStr` and the 16-byte `authTagHex` inside `decipher.final()`, and parses the verified UTF-8 JSON payload (throwing on any key, AAD, IV, or ciphertext tamper).

params.name: envelopeObj.aad
params.description: Recorded Additional Authenticated Data context string.

params.name: secretKeyMaterial
params.description: Operator or swarm master secret key material.

params.name: expectedAadStr
params.description: Expected AAD context string (throws if mismatched).

returns.description: Decrypted and parsed JavaScript value matching the original `payloadObj`.

symbols.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) space where n is the decoded ciphertext byte length.

pillars.name: DIG Network L4 Tokenomics & Secure-The-Bag Rollup
pillars.purpose: Anchoring every single agent thought directly on a Layer-1 blockchain would cost thousands of dollars per month, while purely off-chain storage lacks cryptoeconomic finality and Sybil resistance. This module bridges high-frequency off-chain cognitive commits to Chia L1 via the compiled Chialisp/CLVM WASM driver (`chip35Wasm`): it constructs Chialisp `merkle_utils.clib` (`0x01` leaf / `0x02` internal) payout trees, proves complete L4 DIG capsule + `CHIP-0035` DataLayer Singleton writer delegation + `$DIG` CAT2 + `XCH` fee SpendBundles, executes self-healing state-channel clawbacks that slash poisoned commits to reward bisect healers inside a single "Secure The Bag" batch rollup, consolidates fragmented micro-CAT rings, and quantifies amortized batch economics (~99.9% L1 fee reduction).
invariants: Normative Chialisp Merkle Domain Separation: `buildChialispMerkleBagTree` strictly prefixes leaves with `0x01` and internal nodes with `0x02` to match Chia's `merkle_utils.clib` on-chain puzzle verifier bit-for-bit.

Fail-Closed Coin Selection: `proveDigL4CapsuleAndSpendBundle` aborts before SpendBundle assembly with `INSUFFICIENT_XCH` or `INSUFFICIENT_DIG_CAT` whenever wallet balances cannot cover singleton mojos, fees, or `$DIG` price.

Conservation of State-Channel Value: Self-healing bisect slashing transfers the exact `slashAmount` from the poisoned committer to the bisect healer without inflating or deflating `totalRewardPoolBaseUnits`.

symbols.summary: Builds a Chialisp `merkle_utils.clib` (`0x01` leaf / `0x02` internal) Merkle payout bag tree.
symbols.description: Constructs a Chialisp-compatible binary Merkle tree matching `merkle_utils.clib`: hashes every raw 32-byte leaf as `SHA-256(0x01 || rawLeaf)`, folds adjacent pairs as `SHA-256(0x02 || left || right)` (duplicating an odd trailing node), and exposes `getProof(index)` returning `{ path, proof }` compatible with `chip35Wasm.verifyMerkleMembership`.

returns.description: Bag Merkle root and CLVM-compatible membership proof generator.

symbols.summary: Proves a complete L4 DIG capsule + `CHIP-0035` Singleton update + `$DIG` CAT2 + `XCH` SpendBundle.
symbols.description: Executes a two-tier end-to-end cryptographic proof for promoting a milestone cognitive capsule onto Chia L1 + the DIG Network: - Tier 1 (`@dignetwork/dig-capsule-wasm`): Seals the JSON capsule with `AES-256-GCM-SIV`, builds its Contract D5 Merkle tree, and verifies WASM Merkle inclusion + authenticated decryption round-trip. - Tier 2 (`@dignetwork/chip35-dl-coin-wasm`): Performs `XCH` and `$DIG` CAT2 coin selection, mints & updates the `CHIP-0035` DataLayer Singleton store, builds the `$DIG` treasury payment spend + optional `XCH` fee spend, and serializes the combined Chia `SpendBundle` in canonical hex.
